NOVA Digital

Building an Employer Brand That Gen Z Wants to Join

NOVA Digital
Industry

Audience

Role
Employer Branding & Talent Communication
Year
2026

NOVA Digital is a hypothetical company created for this portfolio. It is not a real client or employer.

The Business Challenge

The challenge wasn't recruitment. It was perception.

NOVA Digital is a hypothetical growing technology company looking to strengthen its position as an attractive workplace for young talent. Although NOVA offers career development opportunities and exposure to innovative projects, its employer brand communication is inconsistent and heavily focused on corporate announcements and recruitment vacancies. Potential candidates have limited visibility into what it is actually like to work at NOVA.

"How can NOVA build an authentic employer brand that makes Gen Z understand, trust, and ultimately want to join the company?"
Research & Insights

Understanding what talent actually looks for.

Five considerations used to frame the strategy for this case study.

01

Career Growth

"Will I actually grow here?"

02

People & Culture

"Who will I be working with?"

03

Meaningful Work

"Will my work have an impact?"

04

Work Environment

"Will I enjoy working here?"

05

Employer Credibility

"Can I trust what the company says about itself?"

"Gen Z doesn't only want to know what a company does. They want to know what their life will look like if they work there."

These are strategic assumptions and portfolio research insights, not findings from a real survey.

Employer Brand Benchmark

Where NOVA sits against the market.

CompanyEmployer Brand StrengthContent ApproachToneEmployee StorytellingStrategic Opportunity for NOVA
GoogleVery strong, globally recognizedPolished, mission-ledAspirationalFrequent, high-productionCompete on relatability, not scale
GojekStrong, locally trustedPurpose & impact storiesWarm, localRegular employee featuresLean into everyday, unscripted moments
ShopeeStrong among Gen ZHigh-energy, trend-drivenPlayful, fast-pacedFrequent short-formMatch the format, not the volume
Bank JagoGrowing, digital-nativeProduct & culture blendedConfident, modernOccasional spotlightsOwn the "career journey" narrative

Many companies communicate "Join Us." NOVA should communicate "Here's what you'll experience when you join us."
